renderer: Chrome frame sheet (rsvg-convert and sips are unavailable on this host)
reproduce: The animated SVG carries one CSS animation per element family, each with a per-item delay in --d.
A frame sheet is built by placing 48 copies of that SVG in one page, each frozen at its own time with animation-delay: -t and animation-play-state: paused.
One full-page Chrome screenshot of that sheet yields every frame at 1200x516; the frames are sliced and assembled with Pillow.
Frames whose difference from the previous frame is at most 2/255 are merged into the previous frame's duration, which is why the settled hold is a single long frame.
Rebuild only when the static design changes: the GIF is a derivative of workflow.svg, never a second source.
